title: A review pass as data
description: What a reviewer reports, as JSON; lib/contract/findings.mjs renders the PR comment and computes the verdict from it. Priority decides the tier: P0 correctness, security, data loss · P1 contract break, regression, missing test · P2 design (SOLID, duplication, layering) · P3 clean code · P4 style. P0 and P1 are "fix before merging", P2 "should fix", P3 and P4 "could improve".

id.description: Stable across passes: an item keeps the number it was first given.

scope.description: pre-existing: a defect in code the diff touches, not introduced by it.

status.description: open when absent. resolved: a previous item the change fixed. noted: seen in a resolution pass, not gating.

new.description: Raised by this pass. Absent means new in a full pass and carried over in a delta or resolution pass.

ticket.description: pre-existing: the ticket tracking it, or null when one is needed.
